title: Brava Theater Center

services.name: Rental
services.desc: We have so much GRATITUDE for all of the incredible artists (performers, teachers, technicians, designers, and creators) who have graced our stages and filled Brava Theater Center with energy and excitement! Every single artist delivered thoughtfully crafted performances and educational experiences inspiring joy, healing, and activism that continues to resonate far beyond Brava’s walls. We are also incredibly appreciative to the over 30,000 of you, both returning and new audiences, who shared these communal moments of joy, reflection, and a deep sense of connection that ONLY THE PERFORMING ARTS can bring. On the flip side, we are experiencing a rise in the cost of doing business by over 35%
